columns.title: DPSE-MUN: Where Young Voices Shape Global Conversations
columns.content:
DPSE-MUN: Where Young Voices Shape Global Conversations

At DPS Eldeco, we don’t just teach our students about the world—we encourage them to step into it, to question it, and to imagine how they can make it better. The DPSE-MUN (Model United Nations), held annually in the month of August, is a shining example of that vision. Entirely student-led, this flagship event brings together young minds to take on the roles of global leaders, diplomats, and change makers.

What makes DPSE-MUN special is the preparation and passion behind it. It’s not just a two-day conference—it’s a journey. The first step begins in May, with the Mock MUN, designed to welcome newcomers and build confidence. Students learn the ropes, understand the format, and step into debate with growing courage.

sections.content:
By the time August arrives, they are ready to take the floor—not just with facts, but with conviction, empathy, and diplomacy. It reflects the power of student initiative and reminds us that age is no barrier when it comes to making a difference.

At DPS Eldeco, we are proud to see our students not just preparing for the future but actively shaping it.

ASSEMBLIES.

Assemblies form a vibrant part of our daily school life, serving as platforms for learning, expression and community building.

Daily Assemblies.

Our regular morning assemblies follow a structured format:

  • ● Begin with the national anthem and school prayer.
  • ● Include a thought for the day and news updates.
  • ● Feature student-led segments like quizzes or presentations.
  • ● Conclude with important announcements.

Special Events

We celebrate various occasions through special assemblies:

  • ●National festivals (Independence Day, Republic Day)
  • ● Cultural festivals (Diwali, Christmas, Eid)
  • ● Annual school events.
  • ● Theme-based learning days.

Student Development

Through assembly participation, students gain:

  • ● Public speaking confidence.
  • ● Leadership opportunities.
  • ● Teamwork experience.
  • ● Cultural awareness.
  • ● Time management skills.

Community Involvement

We encourage parent participation by:

  • ● Inviting them to special assemblies
  • ● Featuring them as guest speakers
  • ● Celebrating parent-oriented events

These gatherings reflect our commitment to holistic education beyond classroom walls, nurturing well-rounded individuals through shared experiences.
